game.name: Darkness, The (Germany)
game.desc: Based on the comic book of the same name, The Darkness is a first-person action game for Xbox 360. You play as Jackie Estacado, a 21 year old mobster, who finds himself one of the hosts of the Darkness, an evil entity infusing him with many powers to enable him to take revenge on his uncle who wants him dead. The Darkness feeds off the shadows, so you must be vigilant in destroying all forms of light, as well as annihilating any enemy that gets in your way.
